support_geometry_audit.conclusion: Increasing uniform bins is not always optimal: fixed nonuniform mean-preserving supports matched 2353 bins with 31 or 101 on wide unused support, but regressed on a large mean offset. No universally superior replacement was established.
support_geometry_audit.capacity_note: 255 remains a declared capacity constraint, not an experimentally optimal bin ceiling.
